Chat request with max_tokens=1 terminates with length finish_reason

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":1,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Write a story\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
```
